context.en: Liu Bang, at right in this later album, is the Gaozu encircled at Baideng.
context.zh: 后世册页右侧的刘邦，即白登被围的汉高祖。

context.en: Li Jing, at left in the album opening, commanded the 630 campaign against the Eastern Turks.
context.zh: 册页左侧的李靖指挥了630年对东突厥的战役。

context.en: The later album portrait identifies Liu Zongyuan, whose Yongzhou exile and landscape essays are central to this entry.
context.zh: 后世册页标识柳宗元；本条以其永州贬谪及山水散文为中心。

context.en: This personal letter is by the reformer Wang Anshi. The linked 1069 crop-loan memorial is a separate policy document.
context.zh: 私人书札出自改革者王安石之手；延伸阅读的1069年青苗法奏议是另一份政策文献。

context.en: NPM identifies the standing ruler as Li Cunxu, founder of Later Tang in 923. The painting’s date is unknown.
context.zh: 故宫将立像人物辨为923年建立后唐的李存勖；画作年代未定。

context.en: The standing portrait is of Li Cunxu, whose Later Tang court at Luoyang is the subject of this entry.
context.zh: 立像表现李存勖，本条以其后唐政权及洛阳朝廷为主题。

context.en: The Longmen relief commemorates Xiaowen, whose capital move and reforms are described here. It was carved after his death.
context.zh: 龙门浮雕纪念本条迁都与改革的主角孝文帝，雕刻完成于其身后。

context.en: The named Ming portrait represents Wang Jian, commander in the conquest of Zhao, not his son Wang Ben.
context.zh: 明代题名画像表现参与灭赵的王翦，而非其子王贲。

context.en: The Qing portrait represents Liu Yu, who founded Liu Song in 420.
context.zh: 清代画像表现420年建立刘宋的刘裕。

context.en: Liu Yu’s later portrait is associated with the founding of Liu Song at Jiankang, rather than all four subsequent dynasties.
context.zh: 刘裕的后世画像对应建康建立刘宋这一事件，而非此后四个王朝的全部历史。

context.en: The 1893 illustration represents Fu Jian, whose accession and appointment of Wang Meng are described here.
context.zh: 1893年插图表现本条所述即位并任用王猛的苻坚。

context.en: Fu Jian commissioned Wang Meng’s campaign. This later portrait represents the ruler, not the fighting at Ye.
context.zh: 苻坚命王猛出征；后世画像表现君主，而非邺城战斗。

context.en: The later portrait represents Fu Jian, ruler of Former Qin during the campaigns summarized here.
context.zh: 后世画像表现这些战役期间的前秦君主苻坚。

context.en: The 1893 named portrait represents Huan Wen, commander of the 347 campaign against Cheng-Han.
context.zh: 1893年题名画像表现347年灭成汉战役的统帅桓温。

context.en: The 1609 book portrait names Li Houzhu, the Li Yu who inherited Southern Tang in 961.
context.zh: 1609年刊本题名“李后主”，即961年继承南唐的李煜。

context.en: The later portrait represents Li Yu, the Southern Tang ruler who surrendered to Song in 975.
context.zh: 后世画像表现975年向宋投降的南唐君主李煜。

context.en: Ma Tai’s 1928 illustration is a later depiction of Zhou Yu at Red Cliffs. The historical account also records Huang Gai’s crucial fire attack.
context.zh: 马骀1928年插图为周瑜在赤壁的后世描绘；史书记载黄盖在火攻中的关键作用。

context.en: Segalen’s 1914 photograph records sculpture at Huo Qubing’s tomb, the funerary commemoration discussed in this entry.
context.zh: 谢阁兰1914年照片记录霍去病墓雕刻，对应本条所述陵墓纪念。

context.en: The eighteenth-century album portrays Wu Zetian, the sovereign whose Zhou dynasty is the subject here.
context.zh: 十八世纪册页描绘本条武周政权的君主武则天。

context.en: The eighteenth-century portrait represents Wu Zetian, who proclaimed Zhou in 690.
context.zh: 十八世纪画像表现690年建立周朝的武则天。

context.en: Wu Zetian’s later portrait supplies the ruler whose abdication ended Zhou in 705.
context.zh: 武则天的后世画像表现705年退位、结束武周统治的君主。

context.en: The late-Ming illustration names Huang Chao, who occupied Chang’an and established a Qi government.
context.zh: 晚明插图题名黄巢，即占领长安并建立齐政权者。

context.en: The Southern Song portrait identifies Han Shizhong, one of the commanders who opposed the Miao–Liu coup.
context.zh: 南宋画像标识参与平定苗刘兵变的将领韩世忠。

context.en: Han Shizhong commanded the Song forces at Huangtiandang.
context.zh: 韩世忠是黄天荡战事中的宋军统帅。

context.en: The 1922 studio photograph is a later likeness of Sun Yat-sen, provisional president at Nanjing in 1912.
context.zh: 1922年照相馆照片为1912年在南京就任临时大总统的孙中山之较晚肖像。

context.en: Sun Yat-sen is the provisional president described here; the photograph was taken in 1922, not at the 1912 inauguration.
context.zh: 孙中山为本条所述临时大总统；照片摄于1922年，不是1912年就职现场。

context.en: Mao is the leader named in this 1949 entry. The photograph shows his 1972 meeting with Nixon, not the founding ceremony.
context.zh: 毛泽东为本条1949年建国叙述中的领导人；照片记录1972年与尼克松会见，而非开国大典。
